lines.beaver_en: Jieun, long time no see. How have you been?
lines.learner: 네, 잘 지냈어요. 이민 간다는 소식 들었어요.
lines.en: Yes, I've been well. I heard you're emigrating.
lines.roman: Ne, jal jinaesseoyo. imin gandaneun sosik deureosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 맞아요. 다음 달에 캐나다로 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, that's right. I'm going to Canada next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, majayo. daeum dare kaenadaro gayo.
lines.en: Wow, are your immigration procedures all done?

lines.beaver_en: Almost done. There was so much paperwork.
lines.en: The procedures must have been complicated. Where will you settle?

lines.beaver_en: I plan to settle in Vancouver. It's close to the sea.
lines.en: Vancouver is famous as a resort too, isn't it?

lines.beaver_en: Right. I hear there are lots of tourists in summer.
lines.en: With so many tourists, isn't housing expensive too?

lines.beaver: 네, 비싸요. 그래서 작은 집을 구했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it is. So I found a small place.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, bissayo. geuraeseo jageun jibeul guhaesseoyo.
lines.learner: 집이 작으면 짐은 필수품만 챙겨 가세요.
lines.en: If the place is small, just pack the essentials.
lines.roman: Jibi jageumyeon jimeun pilsupumman chaenggyeo gaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, I'm only taking clothes and essentials.
lines.learner: 거기 한국 음식은 한국만 못할 거예요.
lines.en: Korean food there won't be as good as in Korea.
lines.roman: Geogi hanguk eumsigeun hangungman motal kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 그래서 김치를 직접 만들 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. That's why I'll make kimchi myself.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. geuraeseo gimchireul jikjeop mandeul kkeoyeyo.
lines.en: Impressive! Do you ever plan to return to Korea?

lines.beaver: 아직 몰라요. 일단 잘 정착하고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: I don't know yet. First I want to settle in well.
lines.beaver_roman: Ajik mollayo. ildan jal jeongchakago sipeoyo.
lines.en: If life there isn't as good as Korea, come back anytime.

lines.beaver: 하하, 고마워요. 떠나기 전에 밥 한번 먹어요.
lines.beaver_en: Haha, thanks. Let's have a meal before I leave.
lines.beaver_roman: Haha, gomawoyo. tteonagi jeone bap hanbeon meogeoyo.
lines.en: Sounds good. I hope you settle in well in Canada.
